column2: * The Collapsing Horizon Unique Quarterstaff now grants 100% increased Elemental Damage (previously 100% increased Elemental Damage with Attacks).
- Fixed a bug where the Collapsing Horizon Unique Quarterstaff was providing its Elemental Gem Level bonus multiple times to Skills with more than one element type.
* Fixed a bug where it was possible to snapshot increases to the level of Elemental Skills using the Collapsing Horizon Unique Quaterstaff.
